UnitStatement: Document title heading: INTENT.
This document records the intent behind the proposed free and open source piping stress analysis software leading to the Product Requirements Document (open_piping_stress_prd.md).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The intent document exists to preserve the governing project philosophy so future design, implementation, governance, and contribution decisions stay aligned with the original objective.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Core intent: build a free and open source piping stress analysis platform implementing the best-known open analytical methods for global piping flexibility and stress analysis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The platform must respect ASME copyrights and other standards-body intellectual property.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The software should provide the engineering workflow, modeling environment, solver, reporting tools, and user interface needed for piping stress analysis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The software must not redistribute proprietary code text, code tables, code-derived formulas, copyrighted examples, material allowable tables, SIF tables, flexibility-factor tables, or protected dimensional standards.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The responsible engineer or organization must provide the code-specific and project-specific information needed to complete a code check.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The project is grounded in the classical piping flexibility and stress-analysis tradition represented by M. W. Kellogg, Design of Piping Systems (1956).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The Kellogg tradition covers material behavior and design limits.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The Kellogg tradition covers pressure, weight, thermal expansion, displacement, sustained, occasional, and repeated-load behavior.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The Kellogg tradition covers local component effects in elbows, bends, branches, reducers, flanges, valves, nozzles, and expansion joints.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The Kellogg tradition covers simplified flexibility methods for hand and preliminary analysis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The Kellogg tradition covers the general analytical method for multi-plane piping systems, branches, restraints, terminal reactions, forces, moments, and stresses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The intent is not to reproduce Kellogg mechanically or limit the software to 1956 methods.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The key insight to preserve is that modern piping stress analysis is fundamentally a centerline / beam / flexibility problem for the vast majority of piping systems.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The classical approach is refined by decades of later theory, better numerical methods, improved component data, better material data, and modern computing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The modern implementation should use a robust 3D frame finite-element solver as the computational successor to the classical flexibility-equation approach.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The global piping system is modeled as connected line elements with six degrees of freedom per node, not as a full 3D solid mesh.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Solid or shell FEA belongs only in specialized local analyses where the normal beam-based pipe stress model is insufficient.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Product identity: an open, auditable, code-neutral piping flexibility and stress-analysis platform that performs the mechanics and lets the user supply the governing code data, material properties, component data, and rule checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The product should not be represented as an open-source copy of ASME B31.1, B31.3, B31J, B16, B36, or any other copyrighted standard.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The product should not claim to be ASME-approved, ASME-certified, officially code-compliant, or endorsed by any standards body.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The public project should not ship B36 pipe dimensional tables copied from standards.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The public project should not ship proprietary commercial software examples or report templates.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The system should require users to provide the code-specific and project-specific information needed to perform a code check.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-supplied code data includes material properties, allowable stresses, temperature-dependent modulus values, thermal expansion data, and yield and ultimate strength values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-supplied code data includes joint factors, weld factors, quality factors, corrosion allowance, and mill tolerance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-supplied code data includes pressure design assumptions, stress-intensification factors, flexibility factors, and stress indices.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-supplied code data includes load combinations, stress equations, allowable limits, cycle factors, occasional load factors, and hydrotest limits.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-supplied code data includes component dimensions, valve face-to-face dimensions, valve weights and centers of gravity, and flange and fitting weights.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-supplied code data includes expansion-joint spring rates and effective pressure areas, nozzle/equipment allowable loads, and owner or company-specific requirements.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The software should make missing code data explicit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The software may solve the global mechanics when enough physical data is present, but should block or clearly qualify any code check when required code-specific values are missing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The project should provide a rule-pack system, not bundled ASME rules.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: A rule pack is a user-supplied or organization-supplied data artifact defining the governing code or internal design basis, required inputs, stress categories, and load combinations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: A rule pack also defines formula expressions, allowable limits, pass/fail criteria, source notes, versioning, checksums, and redistribution status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Public example rule packs should use invented, non-code values and be clearly marked as examples only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Private rule packs may represent a licensed code edition, owner standard, or company practice, but are the user's responsibility and should not be redistributed unless documented redistribution rights exist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should implement the best practical version of global piping stress theory using a modern 3D frame finite-element approach.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine should support nodes with six degrees of freedom, straight pipe elements, bend and elbow elements or bend macro-elements, rigid elements, valves, reducers, and flanges.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine should support branch connections, expansion joints, anchors, guides, line stops, vertical supports, spring hangers, one-way supports, gaps, and friction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine should support imposed anchor and nozzle displacements, weight loads, pressure effects, thermal expansion, and hydrotest cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine should support wind, seismic, and occasional loads, multiple operating cases, load-case algebra, restraint reactions, and equipment terminal loads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine should support stress resultants and code-check inputs and outputs through user-defined rules.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should calculate displacements, rotations, axial forces, shear forces, and torsional moments.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should calculate in-plane, out-of-plane, and resultant bending moments, and pressure thrust where modeled.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should calculate support and restraint loads, equipment/nozzle loads, and section properties.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should calculate axial stress, bending stress, torsional shear stress, and pressure membrane stresses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should calculate optional general-purpose equivalent stresses for engineering review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver should not need to know whether the user is applying ASME B31.1, B31.3, EN 13480, CSA Z662, an owner standard, or another design basis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver calculates the mechanical state; the user-supplied rule pack evaluates acceptability.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI should make piping stress modeling repeatable, transparent, and auditable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI should guide the engineer through creating a project, selecting units, defining design basis metadata, and importing or creating private rule packs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI workflow includes defining materials, defining pipe sections, building 3D piping geometry, and inserting bends, valves, reducers, flanges, branches, expansion joints, and equipment connections.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI workflow includes assigning supports and restraints and assigning pressures, temperatures, insulation, contents, and component weights.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI workflow includes defining primitive load cases, defining combination cases, and solving the analytical model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI workflow includes reviewing displacements, rotations, reactions, forces, and moments, applying user-supplied rule checks, and generating an auditable calculation report.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI should use warnings and blocking checks to distinguish data required to solve the model, data required to perform a code check, and user assumptions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The GUI should also distinguish missing source/provenance information, nonlinear convergence issues, questionable model conditions, and values outside expected engineering ranges.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The product may support component libraries, but public libraries must be handled conservatively.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-INTENT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The project should provide schemas and import tools for component data, and users may maintain private libraries for valves, flanges, fittings, reducers, expansion joints, supports, and equipment connections.
